fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and political commentary on Florida elections, including the governorship race (discussion of Doyle Carlton, Sidney J. Catts, and Fons Hathaway) and support for Ruth Bryan Owen for Congress. Includes local civic and government topics (Dade County commissioners and justice-of-the-peace districts), transportation and road conditions (notably the Tamiami Trail), and prohibition enforcement and contraband liquor incidents involving the county stockade and federal prisoners. Also contains community notes, entertainment listings, and numerous local advertisements and political announcements.
